items.title: Russia-Ukraine talks open in Abu Dhabi; Zelensky calls day one 'constructive'
items.summary: US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks began in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov, the first such round since February. Zelensky called the first day 'constructive and quite substantive', and talks were due to resume the next morning. Rubio called them 'very productive'; European representatives are not in the main sessions.
items.why: Any path to a ceasefire would ease energy and freight costs that weigh on company budgets and hiring.

items.title: G7 in Paris turns to Ukraine support
items.summary: G7 foreign ministers in Paris focused on support for Ukraine while the Abu Dhabi talks ran. It was not clear whether new aid would be announced, and France 24 reports the US and allies appeared far apart on Ukraine, Iran and the International Criminal Court.
items.why: Rifts between the US and Europe shape sanctions, trade rules and the outlook for multinational employers.

items.title: Russia hits Ukraine's grid again as Kyiv strikes a major refinery
items.summary: Russia launched another assault on Ukraine's power grid on Monday, while Ukrainian forces struck another of Russia's largest oil refineries, Al Jazeera reports, even as negotiators met in the UAE.
items.why: Attacks on energy infrastructure keep oil and gas prices volatile.

items.title: COP31 under way in Antalya with over 90,000 expected
items.summary: UN News says more than 90,000 people are expected at COP31 in Türkiye, which aims to turn existing climate commitments into action rather than strike one landmark deal. An EU document reported by Reuters says there is 'no scope' for new climate-finance pledges; that report is relayed second-hand.
items.why: Climate commitments drive ESG reporting and sustainability roles companies are hiring for.

items.title: Strong US inflation data lifts bets on a December Fed hike
items.summary: Stocks and bonds fell on 10 Nov after a strong consumer price report raised bets on a December Fed rate hike, with Fed governor Waller backing a hike, Bloomberg's live coverage says.
items.why: Higher US rates can pull foreign money out of India and cool hiring at global firms.

items.title: President to confer Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 awards today
items.summary: President Droupadi Murmu confers the 10th Swachh Survekshan awards at Vigyan Bhawan on 11 Nov. The survey covered more than 4,751 cities scored on 43 indicators, and a mentorship scheme paired 70 cities with 191 others. Winners are to be announced at the ceremony.
items.why: City rankings shape where employers choose to expand and how cities market themselves.

items.title: Supreme Court asks WhatsApp to act on 'digital arrest' scams
items.summary: A bench led by CJI Surya Kant asked WhatsApp and other platforms to propose measures against digital-arrest scams, and said RBI rules should require financial institutions to compensate cyber-fraud victims, as reported on 10 Nov.
items.why: Fraud-protection duties change how banks and platforms design customer trust and compliance teams.

items.title: Supreme Court presses NCR states on vehicle pollution
items.summary: The Supreme Court ordered Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Haryana to set out plans to cut vehicle emissions in the NCR, in its suo motu air-pollution case; the next hearing is on 23 Nov.
items.why: Air quality affects attendance, productivity and hybrid-work policies across north India.

items.title: Markets reopen after Diwali holiday; Muhurat streak ends
items.summary: Indian exchanges were shut on 10 Nov for Diwali-Balipratipada and reopen today. The Sensex last closed at 81,106.65 and the Nifty at 25,044.65 on 9 Nov, and the Muhurat session ended slightly lower, breaking an eight-year run of gains.
items.why: Market mood feeds into IPO plans and campus hiring sentiment.

items.title: Anthropic begins IPO roadshow; raise reported at up to $64.4bn
items.summary: Bloomberg's live feed flagged Anthropic's IPO roadshow kicking off, with shares offered to retail investors on platforms such as Robinhood and SoFi. Reuters, relayed by Techmeme, reports the IPO could raise up to $64.4 billion; figures are provisional.
items.why: The largest AI listing to date will shape how much companies spend on AI tools for HR and marketing.

items.title: Qantas to cut 850 jobs in Accenture outsourcing deal
items.summary: Qantas said it will cut 850 jobs from mid-2027 after striking an outsourcing deal with Accenture, CEO Vanessa Hudson said.
items.why: A live outsourcing case: how consulting firms take over corporate functions and what it means for workforce plans.

items.title: Honda plans $3bn Ohio hybrid plant with about 2,000 jobs
items.summary: Honda plans a new $3 billion plant in central Ohio to build up to 240,000 hybrid vehicles a year from 2029, creating about 2,000 jobs.
items.why: Large greenfield plants are major talent-acquisition and employer-branding projects.

items.title: Nasdaq slips after inflation report; Sanmina jumps, Lucid misses
items.summary: The Nasdaq fell on 10 Nov after the inflation data. Sanmina shares jumped about 10.9 percent on strong results, while Lucid missed estimates and expanded a loan from a Saudi fund.
items.why: Earnings surprises show which sectors are growing and likely to hire.

items.title: Nvidia board hires Wachtell Lipton for probe tied to CEO
items.summary: Nvidia hired Wachtell Lipton to lead a probe into a relationship involving CEO Jensen Huang, CNBC reports, and the board's independent members issued a statement. A report by The Information about related chip shipments via Chinese firms is unconfirmed.
items.why: A governance crisis at the world's most valuable chipmaker is a live case in leadership and board oversight.

items.title: Google expands 8th-gen TPU lineup to four chips
items.summary: Google expanded its eighth-generation TPU lineup to four chips, and Alphabet shares rose more than 2 percent premarket on the news.
items.why: Cheaper AI compute lowers the cost of AI tools that HR and marketing teams use.

items.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon to developers
items.summary: Google is rolling out Gemini 4 Carbon to paying developers and enterprises at $2 per million input tokens, priced below rival frontier models. A tracker dates the model to late October, so timing is unconfirmed.
items.why: AI price competition makes automation cheaper for business functions.

items.title: Nvidia unveils GR00T 2 robotics model
items.summary: Nvidia unveiled GR00T 2, a 2-billion-parameter vision-language-action model for robots, at CoRL 2026 in Austin, and announced investments in four Korean startups.
items.why: Robotics models will reshape factory and warehouse jobs that HR teams plan for.

items.title: boost.ai launches self-hosted model for regulated industries
items.summary: boost.ai launched Presis, a self-hosted AI model aimed at speed and accuracy in regulated industries such as banking.
items.why: Self-hosted AI eases data-privacy concerns that block HR and customer-service adoption.

items.title: Swachh Survekshan 2025-26 covered over 4,751 cities
items.summary: Cities were scored on 43 indicators across 10 areas in the 10th edition of the survey.
items.why: A data point for public-policy and urban-marketing discussions.

items.title: Muhurat trading closed lower for the first time in eight years
items.summary: The Sensex and Nifty ended the Diwali Muhurat session slightly lower, ending an eight-year streak of positive closes.
items.why: Context for market sentiment around festival season.

items.title: Abu Dhabi round is the first Russia-Ukraine talks since February
items.summary: A Ukrainian delegation source said the 10 Nov meeting was the first such negotiation since February.
items.why: Useful context for geopolitical-risk discussions.
